high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "madovermarketing_mom." The post features a photograph of a large, white, capsule-shaped object floating in space, with Earth's horizon visible in the background. The object has a rectangular screen on its front, displaying a scrolling ticker-tape board with text and images. The text accompanying the image reads: "The exterior of the vessel projected greetings and messages on a scrolling ticker-tape board for our alien friends. Consumers could send their messages to Tic Tac on social media to be featured on the capsule.
